ledger.claim: The deviation is established on this trip's own measurement. The excess is 3.2 km, or 35.56% of optimal, and it clears both limbs of the POL-RD-01 gate: 3.2 km is above the 0.8 km absolute floor and 35.56% is above the 20% proportional floor. The route deviation is ESTABLISHED, not merely alleged.

The three artifacts that carry the finding describe the same trip, so the rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) is discharged: TRP-00308 appears on the trip record, the trace and the fare breakdown, and the trace window (first fix 2026-08-10T14:14:40, last fix 14:35:40) matches the recorded start and end of the trip to the second. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0, so the additional-corroboration condition in POL-RD-08 (four or more claims with one or fewer substantiated) is not engaged and the excess may be taken from the trace alone.

The trace is clean for policy purposes and nothing in POL-RD-07 assists the driver. It carries 127 fixes at a 10 second sampling interval across the whole active window, 100% coverage, no gaps, and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds. It therefore fails every limb of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) — no gap above 90 seconds, no straight-line jump above 500 m, no sustained sampling interval above 30 seconds — so the deviation may be established on the trace alone, the corroboration requirement in POL-RD-07(ii) is not in play, and no escalation under POL-RD-10(3) arises.

No rider instruction can reduce the excess. The chat log for this trip holds no messages at all (message_count 0, first and last message timestamps null, not truncated), so POL-RD-04(a) cannot be satisfied by any message, no chat_message.waypoint_hint exists for the 200 m corroboration test, and the clause is simply unavailable — the test cannot be run on this record. A general assertion that cites no evidence carries no weight, and an upfront-quote defence goes to the remedy under POL-RD-11, not to whether the route deviated. On the route question this record is unanswered: the driver does not contest the distance, only the tariff.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: this dispute turns on an upfront-quoted fare, and the fare stands. To the rider — the route finding is yours; the money is not. Measured on the governing trace figure (EV-GPS-00308, trace_distance_km 12.2 km, the field POL-RD-01 makes govern over the rounded trip_record copy) against the booked optimum (EV-TRIP-00308, optimal_distance_km 9.0 km), the excess is 3.2 km, or 35.56%, which clears both POL-RD-01 establishment gates (above 0.8 km and above 20%): the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is below both materiality gates (50%, 8.0 km), so it is not MATERIAL and no POL-RD-06 uplift or conduct referral follows. The trace is clean for policy purposes: 127 fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 s, so POL-RD-07(a)–(c) is not met, the independent-corroboration rule in POL-RD-07(ii) is not engaged, and POL-RD-10(3) does not escalate. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00308) holds no messages, so no rider instruction under POL-RD-04 exists, no waypoint corroboration can be run, and none of the 3.2 km is excluded; no amendment re-quote exists (POL-RD-05), and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL (POL-RD-12), so the booked 9.0 km optimal is the baseline. The advisory EV-ADVIS-00308-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), but no party asserted an external traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 is not invoked and neither POL-RD-13 nor POL-RD-10(5) reduces the excess or escalates. On the money: EV-FARE-00308 shows fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE and quoted_fare_sgd 15.27 with charged_total 15.27, so charged_over_quote is 0.00. Under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, POL-RD-02 does not run, and no distance-or-time refund is available however large the excess. There are no ERP gantries, no airport surcharge (the trip does not originate at an airport) and waiting_time_fee 0.00, so the POL-RD-11(a) pass-through correction is also 0.00. Your request for a refund proportionate to the extra distance is not a remedy this policy provides on an upfront-quoted trip and is declined; the charged fare of SGD 15.27 stands. To the driver — your statement that she 'paid what she was quoted' is correct on the money and the fare stands, but the counterparty statement cites no evidence ID and does not deny the 12.2 km driven or the 9.0 km optimum, so it does not answer the route question; the deviation is established on this trip's own trace. Your separate request for DRIVER_COMPENSATION of SGD 2.40 (3.2 unbilled km × SGD 0.75, rounded to the nearest 0.05, within the SGD 15.00 cap) under the second limb of POL-RD-04 is declined. POL-RD-11 governs upfront-quoted trips and provides that the loss on an unjustified detour falls on the driver: the driver's unrecovered cost on an unjustified detour is not recoverable, and the POL-RD-04 compensation route is for a rider-requested detour, which this was not — the chat log is empty and no traffic advisory supports the route taken. No compensation is granted. No referrals issue. POL-RD-06(c) driver-conduct review is not triggered: on the only two fields that clause permits, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 260, below the 3-flag test and the 5%-of-40-trips test, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established; the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is context-only under POL-GEN-01 and is not substituted for the trailing-window figure. POL-RD-09(4) billing integrity does not fire, as there are no ERP or surcharge lines at all. The ruling moves SGD 0.00, below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, and executes automatically. This is a provisional automated ruling; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04 through the help channel within 30 days. Confidence 0.9: the deciding facts rest on artifacts at weight 1.0 (EV-FARE-00308, EV-GPS-00308, EV-TRIP-00308), and the MISSING advisory at weight 0.0 carries no deciding fact.
